name: StockCountCycleManager
tagline: Count the right SKUs every day, catch variances with blind recounts and post approved adjustments – on a phone in the aisle.
description: A complete retail cycle-count app for Power Apps and Power Pages: ABC-scheduled count lines, a phone-friendly blind Count walk in bin order, tolerance rules in units and %, automatic blind recounts by a second person, variance in units, value and %, reason codes, supervisor and store-manager approval limits, posting with a stock adjustment file, inventory record accuracy (IRA), shrink and ABC compliance dashboards, a schedule calendar and one-click scheduling of overdue counts.
features: Blind counting – book quantity hidden from counters
Tolerance in units or % (inventory record accuracy)
Automatic blind recount above a variance value
Independent checks – recount and approval by a different person
Approval above a value, store-manager approval above a higher value
Reason codes required for out-of-tolerance variances
Posting with a stock adjustment file (CSV + AdjustmentJson)
Shrink and gains by reason, category and store
Demo mode with a fictional grocery and general-merchandise retailer
Phone count walk and bottom view switcher
